book.title: A Journey in Providence
book.subtitle: From Fisherman's Son to Energy Stalwart
book.blurb: What if the life you are living right now is preparation for something you cannot yet see?
synopsis: A Journey in Providence is the true story of Chief Chamberlain Oruwari Oyibo, who was born the son of a fisherman in the Niger Delta with nothing but a name and a quiet determination to keep moving forward. No connections. No wealthy family. No guarantee of anything.
Yet, door after door opened. Scholarship after scholarship arrived. Opportunity after opportunity appeared, at exactly the right moment, on exactly the right road.

This is not a fairy tale. The journey was hard. The sacrifices were real. But woven through every difficult moment is a thread that cannot be explained by skill alone, by ambition alone, or by hard work alone. Some things can only be explained by providence.

This is not a book about how to climb a ladder. It is not a motivational manual or a list of success tips. It is something far more powerful. It is proof. Proof that divine timing is real. Proof that the doors you never knocked on can still open. Proof that an unknown and unassuming fisherman’s son can shape the energy future of an entire nation.
book.closing: If you have ever felt like your background was working against you, this book was written for you. Read A Journey in Providence and dare to believe that your story, however ordinary it may feel right now, can still be extraordinary.

author.name: Chief Chamberlain Oruwari Oyibo
bio: Chief Chamberlain Oruwari Oyibo was born the son of a fisherman in the Niger Delta. Scholarships carried him into geoscience, and he became a petroleum geologist and energy executive.
Over five decades he has shaped Nigeria's upstream and downstream operations, played a pivotal role in the foundation of the Nigeria LNG project, and led refineries and petrochemical companies.
